translations.web: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
translations.bsb: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
translations.kjv: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
translations.asv: For then will I turn to the peoples of a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Jehovah, to serve him with one consent.
